act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

classification.offence: Assault or use of criminal force on grave and sudden provocation.
classification.punishment: Simple imprisonment for one month, or fine of 1,000 rupees, or both.

section.heading: Assault or criminal force on grave provocation
section.html:
Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any person on grave and sudden provocation given by that person, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to one month, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.

Explanation.—This section is subject to the same Explanation as section 131.
